title: Agent Normal Form
body_html:
Agent Normal Form

For a perfect-recall extensive form game $\Gamma$, the agent normal form $\Gamma^a$ replaces each information set $Q$ of $\Gamma$ by a distinct agent $i(Q)$.

The agent at $Q$ has the same payoff function as the original player who moves at $Q$. Thus a single original player is duplicated into a team of agents, one for each information set, all with common interests.

Since each agent moves at most once, mixed and behavioral strategies coincide in the agent normal form.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 6.6.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Agent normal form of a perfect-recall extensive form game.
